subject: Vendor onboarding: minimal invoice fields for email fallback
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:12:00Z
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Jordan,

We’re getting set up in your vendor portal but a couple of our smaller facilities still send invoices via email. Can you confirm what minimum fields we should include if we end up emailing invoices (so our AP team can avoid manual rework)?

A few specifics we care about:
- Does the PO number need to be embedded in the subject line or in the body?
- Do you require a line-item breakdown or is a total sufficient for the fallback flow?
- Is a PDF attachment required, or can the invoice live inline in the email?

Thanks — happy to follow whatever format speeds processing.

—
Liam O'Connor
Finance Operations Manager
BrightWave
liam.oconnor@brightwave.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightwave.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Thanks for the quick note, Liam. Looping in Vanessa and Kim to lock down the minimal email fallback contract we can accept while still hitting AP SLAs.

Vanessa / Kim — short ask: can we agree on a minimal email schema that our AP intake can auto-parse (or at least map automatically into our portal) so vendors like BrightWave can keep sending emails without manual intervention? Goal is: 1) unambiguous PO match, 2) automated acknowledgement, 3) clear remittance.

I sketched a candidate minimum below — open to edits:
- Subject convention: INVOICE | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | <VENDOR_NAME>
- Required fields in email body: Invoice number, Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), PO number, Invoice total (currency), Vendor legal name, Remit-to bank or payment instructions (can be a short code that maps to saved bank info)
- Attachment: single PDF invoice strongly preferred; if no attachment, require CSV or a compact table in body with line totals.
- File name convention (if attaching): <VENDORNAME>_INV_<INVOICENUM>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf

Marissa — can you attach the small CSV sample we used in last onboarding? I think that will help BrightWave format quickly.

Jordan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightwave.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T20:30:00Z
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Jordan — thanks, this is in line with what AP needs. A few clarifications and an exception path:

Final proposal for email fallback (required):
- Subject prefix: INVOICE: PO-<PO_NUMBER> (exactly this format)
- Email body required fields (clear labels, not embedded PDFs only):
  - Invoice number
  - Invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
  - Redwood PO number
  - Invoice amount (currency + amount)
  - Vendor legal name (as registered)
- Attachment policy: A single PDF is required in 99% of cases. If a PDF cannot be produced, a CSV following our compact template is acceptable.
- Line items: not required for email fallback, but if included they must show a line total and currency.

Exception: Non-PO invoices (one-off contractors or reimbursements) must include a vendor ID and a reason code; these will route to a manual queue.

Operational notes:
- Acknowledgement: our intake system will send an automatic receipt when subject follows the prefix exactly.
- PO mismatch: if the PO in subject doesn’t match a PO in the portal, the message will open a 48-hour exception window and route to AP for review.

I attached a compact CSV sample and a short markdown guide to subject formatting.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: email-fallback-invoice-template.csv, invoice-subject-guidelines.md
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightwave.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T22:05:00Z
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Quick add from a compliance angle:
- For US vendors, require tax identifier on onboarding (we store it in vendor profile). If the invoice comes without the vendor ID, include a link in the auto-reply asking them to complete vendor profile and attach W-9 if not already on file.
- Remittance: do not accept remittance changes via unencrypted email. If BrightWave needs to change remit-to details, we will send a secure remit-change request link to their vendor admin.

Otherwise this looks good and keeps the portal as the primary. Happy to approve the proposed wording for the onboarding task.

—
Kimberly Park
Vendor Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:05:00Z
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission options

Liam — thanks for the patience. To summarize the agreed email-fallback format for BrightWave:

1) Subject line: INVOICE: PO-<PO_NUMBER>
2) Email body must include labeled fields: Invoice number, Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), Redwood PO number, Invoice total (currency), Vendor legal name
3) Attachment: single PDF invoice preferred. If no PDF, use the attached CSV template (see email-fallback-invoice-template.csv).
4) Remittance/account changes: do not send bank details over plain email. We will request a remit-change through our secure form if needed.

Next steps: please send one sample invoice using the CSV or the subject convention and we’ll confirm auto-ack behavior from our intake system. If everything parses cleanly we’ll mark your account as having email-fallback enabled.

Appreciate it — Jordan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
